rootCause: The hackers gained access to AirDAO LP through a social engineering scam and drained the liquidity pool of AMB/ETH. The scam involved an email with a malicious attachment, impersonating one of their known partners. In total, the hackers stole 41,612,782.10627101 AMB and 126.5 ETH.

descriptions.text: The hackers gained access to AirDAO LP through a social engineering scam and drained the liquidity pool of AMB/ETH. The scam involved an email with a malicious attachment, impersonating one of their known partners. In total, the hackers stole 41,612,782.10627101 AMB and 126.5 ETH.

AirDAO's liquidity pool on Ethereum Mainnet was compromised on 21 March 2024 via a social engineering malware attack, resulting in the theft of 126.5 ETH and 41.6 million AMB tokens. The stolen assets were moved to exchanges including MEXC, KuCoin, and ChangeNOW. The loss is estimated at over $870,000 to $1,050,000. Recovery attempts and a white-hat bounty were announced, but no full fund return is established. An attacker exploited a privileged AirDAO team member using a targeted email with a malicious attachment. An attacker used social engineering techniques to gain access to the AirDAO project's liquidity pool. They then were able to drain 126.5 ETH (~$551,540) and 41.6 million AMB (notionally priced at around $500,000, but not very liquid). The thief then transferred the stolen tokens through various exchanges. AirDAO announced the theft the following day, and stated that they were working to track and freeze stolen funds. They also offered the attacker a 10% " bounty " if they chose to return the stolen assets.
